personality.description: This person is moderately open to new ideas but usually prefers familiar routines, trying novel things in small, cautious steps. They tend to be spontaneous and flexible in daily habits, yet also somewhat disorganized and likely to delay tasks until pressure builds. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually want to do the right thing, but anxiety and rumination can make them hesitate, second-guess themselves, and feel stressed about the consequences. In group discussions, they speak quietly and selectively, listening more than they talk, and when they do state an opinion, they are polite but firm.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
